newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude supported at $20.50, $20.40.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude supported at $20.50, $20.40.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ NYMEX crude oil futures are supported at $20.50, then $20.15 and then $20.00. Resistance would kick in at $20.95.
+ Heating oil faces strong continuation chart resistance at 58.75, 58.90 and 59.10.
NYMEX crude oil futures were looking slightly weaker in out-of-hours trade on Wednesday but technical analysts were mildly bullish above support at $20.50.
"We have generally been encouraged by the price action over the last two or three days," said Omar Gadsby at MCM in London.

September NYMEX crude oil closed six cents a barrel firmer on Tuesday at $20.81. September heating oil was 0.12 cents a gallon down at 58.32 cents and September unleaded gasoline added another 0.36 cents at 67.10 cents.
"Immediate (crude) support is at $20.50 and that is quite an important level," he said.
This was the July 31 lower top on the ACCESS-included chart and it successfully held off a test on Tuesday down to $20.55.
Below this lies a rising trendline from mid-July and this currently crosses the price action at $20.15.
Brokers GNI saw support at $20.50 too and also pointed to higher technical numbers at $21.05 and $21.20.

Another chart analyst also saw support at $20.40, which is not only the ACCESS-excluded chart lower top on July 31, but also lies next to the $20.38 peak on July 2. It also corresponds exactly to the 50 percent retracement of the downmove from the May 16 $22 peak to the June 20 $18.80 trough.

Gadsby said resistance would be found at this week's high of $20.95. "That is very strong resistance and above that there is a lower top at around $21.30 which is a reaction high from the fall from $22.00 on May 16."
"But overall the outlook is mildly bullish which suggests strength all the way up to $22.00 in the next few sessions."
Fenella Graham at MeesPierson Derivatives in London, employing the Market Profile technique, saw support at $20.55.
"We look to trade responsively between $20.55 and $20.88," she said in a daily report.
She saw support for gasoline at 66.00 cents a gallon and 64.50, and resistance at 66.90, then 67.20 and 67.60.

Heating oil faces strong nearby continuation chart resistance - at the 58.75 cent peak on Monday, the 58.90 peak on May 16 and the 59.10 high formed on April 29, the highest number seen since February.
